regulations.notes: Tybee Island requires annual STR certificates (renewable Jan-Mar). In 2024, the City Council approved an amendment terminating STVR permits in R-1, R-1-B, and R-2 zones upon sale of the home — effectively reducing the STR inventory over time. Existing pre-June 2024 certificates may continue. A Feb 2026 draft ordinance proposed adding 118 new STVRs but with an overall cap.
regulations.pending_legislation: Draft ordinance (Feb 2026) to add 118 STVRs with a citywide cap
